description: This is the official code and supplementary materials for our AAAI-2024 paper: MASTER: Market-Guided Stock Transformer for Stock Price Forecasting. MASTER is a stock transformer for stock price forecasting, which models the momentary and cross-time stock correlation and guide feature selection with market information.
